storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry cupboard for 6 to 12 months; in monsoon or a warm kitchen, the fridge keeps the oils fresh. Soaked chia keeps 2 to 3 days in the fridge.
looksLike: Tiny, oval, grey-black seeds with white-and-brown speckles. In liquid they swell and form a clear gel coat around each seed (the soaked seeds look jelly-like).
howToPick: Look for dry, loose, uniform grey-black seeds with no clumps, no musty or rancid smell, and a sealed pack. Check the label says 100% chia (not a seed mix) and note the packing date.
shelfLife: About 12 to 18 months sealed (check the printed best-before date).
